Features

Made with Whole Grain Oats: Each serving includes 16 grams of whole grains for sustained energy and fiber.

Sweetened with Real Honey: Light, natural sweetness from real honey enhances flavor without being overpowering.

Simple, Recognizable Ingredients: Includes oats, sugar, honey, canola oil, rice flour, salt, and natural flavors.

No Artificial Flavors or Colors: Free from artificial additives and high-fructose corn syrup.

Gluten-Free: A great option for those avoiding gluten (check packaging to confirm).

Two-Bar Packs: Individually wrapped for freshness and convenience — perfect for snacking on the go.

Crunchy Texture: Signature crispness that makes every bite satisfying.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Canola Oil, Rice Flour, Honey, Salt, Brown Sugar Syrup, Baking Soda, Soy Lecithin, Natural Flavor
